caption: The drawing consists of two main objects on a light beige background. On the left side, there is a black line drawing depicting a stylized floral motif with two large, radially symmetric flowers and several elongated, curved leaves and tendrils extending outward from the base. To the right of this, there is a detailed, colored rendering of a brown, irregularly-shaped shard or fragment. This shard also has a carved or embossed design on its surface, featuring a similar floral and leafy pattern as the line drawing, with swirls, flowers, and leafy elements in relief. The shard is primarily brown with some areas showing subtle greenish-grey and darker brown shading, giving it a three-dimensional appearance. The objects are separated, with the line art on the left and the colored shard to the right, occupying the center-bottom of the composition. The background remains plain with no additional elements.
title: Calico Printing Block
